meta.title: The Center Cannot Hold
meta.description: Some stories starts with something breaking apart. In the cup of the cosmos, we must reconstitute a cube of sugar.

units.rawText: Sqqquueeeaak—
units.displayText: Sqqquueeeaak—

spans.text: Sqqquueeeaak—

units.rawText: The miniature Entropic welcomes the newcomer and they step up. Hubble's steps were far lighter than before—rather, the steps resemble more of a gait now.
units.displayText: The miniature Entropic welcomes the newcomer and they step up. Hubble's steps were far lighter than before—rather, the steps resemble more of a gait now.

spans.text: The miniature Entropic welcomes the newcomer and they step up. Hubble's steps were far lighter than before—rather, the steps resemble more of a gait now.

units.rawText: She steps onto the spaceship's floors, maintaining a state of levitation even under the effects of the gravity system. It is as if gravity, whether natural or artificial, is only a minuscule part of her authority's reach, something for her to toy with.
units.displayText: She steps onto the spaceship's floors, maintaining a state of levitation even under the effects of the gravity system. It is as if gravity, whether natural or artificial, is only a minuscule part of her authority's reach, something for her to toy with.

spans.text: She steps onto the spaceship's floors, maintaining a state of levitation even under the effects of the gravity system. It is as if gravity, whether natural or artificial, is only a minuscule part of her authority's reach, something for her to toy with.

units.rawText: We meet again. ...Is it "again"?
units.displayText: We meet again. ...Is it "again"?

spans.text: We meet again. ...Is it "again"?

units.rawText: Hubble...
units.displayText: Hubble...

spans.text: Hubble...

units.rawText: Fresnel.
units.displayText: Fresnel.

spans.text: Fresnel.

units.rawText: A foreign gaze, a foreign set of mannerisms. As certain as we were that this was the very person we once knew, we can still sense that she has undergone a staggering change.
units.displayText: A foreign gaze, a foreign set of mannerisms. As certain as we were that this was the very person we once knew, we can still sense that she has undergone a staggering change.

spans.text: A foreign gaze, a foreign set of mannerisms. As certain as we were that this was the very person we once knew, we can still sense that she has undergone a staggering change.

units.rawText: Familiar yet strange—not just her to us, but us to her as well.
units.displayText: Familiar yet strange—not just her to us, but us to her as well.

spans.text: Familiar yet strange—not just her to us, but us to her as well.

units.rawText: Is something the matter? Looking at me like that... or have we not spoken in some time?
units.displayText: Is something the matter? Looking at me like that... or have we not spoken in some time?

spans.text: Is something the matter? Looking at me like that... or have we not spoken in some time?

units.rawText: She flashes us that smile again, buzzing with interest. The sheer alienness in the act divulges her countless indifferences—about farewells, about reunions, about protection and sacrifice.
units.displayText: She flashes us that smile again, buzzing with interest. The sheer alienness in the act divulges her countless indifferences—about farewells, about reunions, about protection and sacrifice.

spans.text: She flashes us that smile again, buzzing with interest. The sheer alienness in the act divulges her countless indifferences—about farewells, about reunions, about protection and sacrifice.

units.rawText: As if they are naught more than trifles to her.
units.displayText: As if they are naught more than trifles to her.

spans.text: As if they are naught more than trifles to her.

units.rawText: Why do you—
units.displayText: Why do you—

spans.text: Why do you—

units.rawText: Don't get too close, Fresnel. I cannot fully "control myself".
units.displayText: Don't get too close, Fresnel. I cannot fully "control myself".

spans.text: Don't get too close, Fresnel. I cannot fully "control myself".

units.rawText: Is it... a result of the Entropization?
units.displayText: Is it... a result of the Entropization?

spans.text: Is it... a result of the Entropization?

units.rawText: Hubble, do you feel unwell anywhere? Does the Entropization... hurt?
units.displayText: Hubble, do you feel unwell anywhere? Does the Entropization... hurt?

spans.text: Hubble, do you feel unwell anywhere? Does the Entropization... hurt?

units.rawText: Shh.
units.displayText: Shh.

spans.text: Shh.

units.rawText: Orbits cross, meet, and detach. To meet again in the eternal night is not a bizarre thing.
units.displayText: Orbits cross, meet, and detach. To meet again in the eternal night is not a bizarre thing.

spans.text: Orbits cross, meet, and detach. To meet again in the eternal night is not a bizarre thing.

units.rawText: Now, I am not unlike a slumbering star. I shift through dormant orbits, until I meet my alien star.
units.displayText: Now, I am not unlike a slumbering star. I shift through dormant orbits, until I meet my alien star.

spans.text: Now, I am not unlike a slumbering star. I shift through dormant orbits, until I meet my alien star.

units.rawText: Would the moniker of Darkstar Hubble be to your liking?
units.displayText: Would the moniker of Darkstar Hubble be to your liking?

spans.text: Would the moniker of Darkstar Hubble be to your liking?

units.rawText: Darkstar... Hubble...
units.displayText: Darkstar... Hubble...

spans.text: Darkstar... Hubble...

units.rawText: Fresnel slowly repeats the name, and earns an approving nod from Hubble.
units.displayText: Fresnel slowly repeats the name, and earns an approving nod from Hubble.

spans.text: Fresnel slowly repeats the name, and earns an approving nod from Hubble.

units.rawText: A reunion differing from expectations extinguishes Fresnel's excitement. She light repeats it again, and falls into wordlessness.
units.displayText: A reunion differing from expectations extinguishes Fresnel's excitement. She light repeats it again, and falls into wordlessness.

spans.text: A reunion differing from expectations extinguishes Fresnel's excitement. She light repeats it again, and falls into wordlessness.

units.rawText: Welcome back, Hubble—please do allow me to call you that still. I think that is what Fresnel would have wanted as well.
units.displayText: Welcome back, Hubble—please do allow me to call you that still. I think that is what Fresnel would have wanted as well.

spans.text: Welcome back, Hubble—please do allow me to call you that still. I think that is what Fresnel would have wanted as well.

units.rawText: I clear my throat and attempt to communicate with her. Hubble's demeanor is far more disorderly than before. Unlike our other friends tortured by the tormentous process of Entropization, Hubble remains very much herself in regard to her state.
units.displayText: I clear my throat and attempt to communicate with her. Hubble's demeanor is far more disorderly than before. Unlike our other friends tortured by the tormentous process of Entropization, Hubble remains very much herself in regard to her state.

spans.text: I clear my throat and attempt to communicate with her. Hubble's demeanor is far more disorderly than before. Unlike our other friends tortured by the tormentous process of Entropization, Hubble remains very much herself in regard to her state.

units.rawText: We have not been apart for too long. We are here for you, in fact.
units.displayText: We have not been apart for too long. We are here for you, in fact.

spans.text: We have not been apart for too long. We are here for you, in fact.

units.rawText: When people have reunions, they often intuitively say "thank goodness you're alright". In this situation, though, "alright" swims in my mind. I cannot bring myself to say it so easily.
units.displayText: When people have reunions, they often intuitively say "thank goodness you're alright". In this situation, though, "alright" swims in my mind. I cannot bring myself to say it so easily.

spans.text: When people have reunions, they often intuitively say "thank goodness you're alright". In this situation, though, "alright" swims in my mind. I cannot bring myself to say it so easily.

units.rawText: But moving past the pleasantries, I wanted to ask... is your body truly fine? Do you feel any discomfort?
units.displayText: But moving past the pleasantries, I wanted to ask... is your body truly fine? Do you feel any discomfort?

spans.text: But moving past the pleasantries, I wanted to ask... is your body truly fine? Do you feel any discomfort?

units.rawText: Hm. The celestial body's density and structure are all very normal... but something always feels missing.
units.displayText: Hm. The celestial body's density and structure are all very normal... but something always feels missing.

spans.text: Hm. The celestial body's density and structure are all very normal... but something always feels missing.

units.rawText: Hubble's face is covered with ostensibly real perplexion, and her thoughts appear to be clouded. She puts a finger to her chin, her thinking countenance showing a little bit of rarely-before-seen naivete.
units.displayText: Hubble's face is covered with ostensibly real perplexion, and her thoughts appear to be clouded. She puts a finger to her chin, her thinking countenance showing a little bit of rarely-before-seen naivete.

spans.text: Hubble's face is covered with ostensibly real perplexion, and her thoughts appear to be clouded. She puts a finger to her chin, her thinking countenance showing a little bit of rarely-before-seen naivete.

units.rawText: To think of it, there are quite a few parts missing... memories, body, how it feels to be in control...
units.displayText: To think of it, there are quite a few parts missing... memories, body, how it feels to be in control...

spans.text: To think of it, there are quite a few parts missing... memories, body, how it feels to be in control...

units.rawText: From memory data to sensory input from the world, what remains is largely faraway glimmers and remnant fuzzy shades.
units.displayText: From memory data to sensory input from the world, what remains is largely faraway glimmers and remnant fuzzy shades.

spans.text: From memory data to sensory input from the world, what remains is largely faraway glimmers and remnant fuzzy shades.

units.rawText: So the memories are also... well, what do you remember?
units.displayText: So the memories are also... well, what do you remember?

spans.text: So the memories are also... well, what do you remember?

units.rawText: As we can see, at least you still remember us—even this little guy.
units.displayText: As we can see, at least you still remember us—even this little guy.

spans.text: As we can see, at least you still remember us—even this little guy.

units.rawText: Squeal?
units.displayText: Squeal?

spans.text: Squeal?

units.rawText: The miniature Entropics crawls up the surface of Hubble's legs, clambering onto her arm and reclining there placidly like a small animal.
units.displayText: The miniature Entropics crawls up the surface of Hubble's legs, clambering onto her arm and reclining there placidly like a small animal.

spans.text: The miniature Entropics crawls up the surface of Hubble's legs, clambering onto her arm and reclining there placidly like a small animal.

units.rawText: Well, about that... I can't say I know either. About you, I can remember so very little...
units.displayText: Well, about that... I can't say I know either. About you, I can remember so very little...

spans.text: Well, about that... I can't say I know either. About you, I can remember so very little...

units.rawText: The past's traces are fragments and broken, and the future's tracks are murky and unclear. I patiently await the time when I might meet my alien star...
units.displayText: The past's traces are fragments and broken, and the future's tracks are murky and unclear. I patiently await the time when I might meet my alien star...

spans.text: The past's traces are fragments and broken, and the future's tracks are murky and unclear. I patiently await the time when I might meet my alien star...

units.rawText: Alien star?
units.displayText: Alien star?

spans.text: Alien star?

units.rawText: Quickly catching onto her terminology, I move to ask further, but Hubble moves on of her own accord. Her words do not seem to have any real goal, simply a meandering walk through her thoughts.
units.displayText: Quickly catching onto her terminology, I move to ask further, but Hubble moves on of her own accord. Her words do not seem to have any real goal, simply a meandering walk through her thoughts.

spans.text: Quickly catching onto her terminology, I move to ask further, but Hubble moves on of her own accord. Her words do not seem to have any real goal, simply a meandering walk through her thoughts.

units.rawText: The position of time, the whispers of nebulae—meaningless to me.
units.displayText: The position of time, the whispers of nebulae—meaningless to me.

spans.text: The position of time, the whispers of nebulae—meaningless to me.

units.rawText: Whether it's the Professor or Fresnel... it's all remnant pieces...
units.displayText: Whether it's the Professor or Fresnel... it's all remnant pieces...

spans.text: Whether it's the Professor or Fresnel... it's all remnant pieces...

units.rawText: They tremble in my neural cloud, humming, radiating strange light... but I know not what meaning they hold.
units.displayText: They tremble in my neural cloud, humming, radiating strange light... but I know not what meaning they hold.

spans.text: They tremble in my neural cloud, humming, radiating strange light... but I know not what meaning they hold.

units.rawText: Fragmented starlight still shines. Interesting, is it not?
units.displayText: Fragmented starlight still shines. Interesting, is it not?

spans.text: Fragmented starlight still shines. Interesting, is it not?

units.rawText: Hubble's hand reaches toward her chest, as if there was really a dazzling nebulae nested there, as hot as a fervently beating heart.
units.displayText: Hubble's hand reaches toward her chest, as if there was really a dazzling nebulae nested there, as hot as a fervently beating heart.

spans.text: Hubble's hand reaches toward her chest, as if there was really a dazzling nebulae nested there, as hot as a fervently beating heart.

units.rawText: She looks to me, then to Fresnel, without a hint of excitement at this reunion.
units.displayText: She looks to me, then to Fresnel, without a hint of excitement at this reunion.

spans.text: She looks to me, then to Fresnel, without a hint of excitement at this reunion.

units.rawText: As for the other matters, I dare say they are scattered here, in this dream. They make space no longer empty. I'm quite fond of it.
units.displayText: As for the other matters, I dare say they are scattered here, in this dream. They make space no longer empty. I'm quite fond of it.

spans.text: As for the other matters, I dare say they are scattered here, in this dream. They make space no longer empty. I'm quite fond of it.

units.rawText: You're saying this Starsphere... is a dream?
units.displayText: You're saying this Starsphere... is a dream?

spans.text: You're saying this Starsphere... is a dream?

units.rawText: Is it not? Though it matters not... what I see when I am asleep and awake... are growing more and more alike.
units.displayText: Is it not? Though it matters not... what I see when I am asleep and awake... are growing more and more alike.

spans.text: Is it not? Though it matters not... what I see when I am asleep and awake... are growing more and more alike.

units.rawText: When I simply look upon things like this, it makes me drowsy.
units.displayText: When I simply look upon things like this, it makes me drowsy.

spans.text: When I simply look upon things like this, it makes me drowsy.

units.rawText: What are you here for? Whatever it is, it appears interesting... might you take me along with you?
units.displayText: What are you here for? Whatever it is, it appears interesting... might you take me along with you?

spans.text: What are you here for? Whatever it is, it appears interesting... might you take me along with you?

units.rawText: She delivers her missive with a light smile, but that starlight never seems to truly suffuse her eyes. Her voice is alluring, like a vortex in the midst of a nightly voyage, stirring and gathering, threatening to swallow all that is in sight.
units.displayText: She delivers her missive with a light smile, but that starlight never seems to truly suffuse her eyes. Her voice is alluring, like a vortex in the midst of a nightly voyage, stirring and gathering, threatening to swallow all that is in sight.

spans.text: She delivers her missive with a light smile, but that starlight never seems to truly suffuse her eyes. Her voice is alluring, like a vortex in the midst of a nightly voyage, stirring and gathering, threatening to swallow all that is in sight.

units.rawText: The feeling of familiarity is all too transient, and an air of peril soon arrives.
units.displayText: The feeling of familiarity is all too transient, and an air of peril soon arrives.

spans.text: The feeling of familiarity is all too transient, and an air of peril soon arrives.
Of course.
What are your intentions?

units.rawText: Allow me to say "welcome back" one more time. We have a lot to do.
units.displayText: Allow me to say "welcome back" one more time. We have a lot to do.

spans.text: Allow me to say "welcome back" one more time. We have a lot to do.

units.rawText: No misgivings at all... or rather, are you perhaps overconfident in your current situation?
units.displayText: No misgivings at all... or rather, are you perhaps overconfident in your current situation?

spans.text: No misgivings at all... or rather, are you perhaps overconfident in your current situation?

units.rawText: Hehe, you do indeed give off a dazzling light. Do you guide other planets in their paths so?
units.displayText: Hehe, you do indeed give off a dazzling light. Do you guide other planets in their paths so?

spans.text: Hehe, you do indeed give off a dazzling light. Do you guide other planets in their paths so?

units.rawText: In truth these things shouldn't be said to friends... but seeing as we just had an altercation, I cannot help but wonder about your thoughts.
units.displayText: In truth these things shouldn't be said to friends... but seeing as we just had an altercation, I cannot help but wonder about your thoughts.

spans.text: In truth these things shouldn't be said to friends... but seeing as we just had an altercation, I cannot help but wonder about your thoughts.

units.rawText: Apprehensive towards a planet that's undergone transformation... an enlightened star is charming indeed.
units.displayText: Apprehensive towards a planet that's undergone transformation... an enlightened star is charming indeed.

spans.text: Apprehensive towards a planet that's undergone transformation... an enlightened star is charming indeed.

units.rawText: Your light is a little harsh on the eyes... but perhaps it is that light which captivates gazes of longing.
units.displayText: Your light is a little harsh on the eyes... but perhaps it is that light which captivates gazes of longing.

spans.text: Your light is a little harsh on the eyes... but perhaps it is that light which captivates gazes of longing.

units.rawText: Relax, I harbor no ill will towards you. At least for the time being...
units.displayText: Relax, I harbor no ill will towards you. At least for the time being...

spans.text: Relax, I harbor no ill will towards you. At least for the time being...

units.rawText: Won't you welcome me as well, Fresnel?
units.displayText: Won't you welcome me as well, Fresnel?

spans.text: Won't you welcome me as well, Fresnel?

units.rawText: I—
units.displayText: I—

spans.text: I—

units.rawText: Ever since Hubble interrupted her, Fresnel has maintained her silence. But with this turn of events, apart from her low spirits, something else seems to lurk in her eyes.
units.displayText: Ever since Hubble interrupted her, Fresnel has maintained her silence. But with this turn of events, apart from her low spirits, something else seems to lurk in her eyes.

spans.text: Ever since Hubble interrupted her, Fresnel has maintained her silence. But with this turn of events, apart from her low spirits, something else seems to lurk in her eyes.

units.rawText: I... had a lot I wanted to say, but I can't bring myself to get any of it out.
units.displayText: I... had a lot I wanted to say, but I can't bring myself to get any of it out.

spans.text: I... had a lot I wanted to say, but I can't bring myself to get any of it out.

units.rawText: If that's what you want to hear right now, then... welcome back.
units.displayText: If that's what you want to hear right now, then... welcome back.

spans.text: If that's what you want to hear right now, then... welcome back.

units.rawText: Welcome back, Hubble. I've missed you. We all have.
units.displayText: Welcome back, Hubble. I've missed you. We all have.

spans.text: Welcome back, Hubble. I've missed you. We all have.

units.rawText: Fresnel gives Hubble a smile not so different from before, a million unspoken words hidden beneath. She extends her hands towards Hubble, giving a slow but firm hug.
units.displayText: Fresnel gives Hubble a smile not so different from before, a million unspoken words hidden beneath. She extends her hands towards Hubble, giving a slow but firm hug.

spans.text: Fresnel gives Hubble a smile not so different from before, a million unspoken words hidden beneath. She extends her hands towards Hubble, giving a slow but firm hug.

units.rawText: Perhaps there are many problems between us that we'll have to solve now—but it's alright. We'll work through all of it.
units.displayText: Perhaps there are many problems between us that we'll have to solve now—but it's alright. We'll work through all of it.

spans.text: Perhaps there are many problems between us that we'll have to solve now—but it's alright. We'll work through all of it.

units.rawText: We will. Surely.
units.displayText: We will. Surely.

spans.text: We will. Surely.

units.rawText: Hehe... do your very best then. I'm looking forward to it.
units.displayText: Hehe... do your very best then. I'm looking forward to it.

spans.text: Hehe... do your very best then. I'm looking forward to it.

units.rawText: Hubble returns the embrace in a superficial manner. She immediately rises to her full height afterward, as if suddenly recalling something.
units.displayText: Hubble returns the embrace in a superficial manner. She immediately rises to her full height afterward, as if suddenly recalling something.

spans.text: Hubble returns the embrace in a superficial manner. She immediately rises to her full height afterward, as if suddenly recalling something.

units.rawText: Ah, right. Don't we have some new friends from outside patched in here?
units.displayText: Ah, right. Don't we have some new friends from outside patched in here?

spans.text: Ah, right. Don't we have some new friends from outside patched in here?

units.rawText: It's hardly proper not to offer greetings when engaging in interplanetary communication.
units.displayText: It's hardly proper not to offer greetings when engaging in interplanetary communication.

spans.text: It's hardly proper not to offer greetings when engaging in interplanetary communication.

units.rawText: ...Huff.
units.displayText: ...Huff.

spans.text: ...Huff.

units.rawText: You've gotten a lot more abrasive, Hubble.
units.displayText: You've gotten a lot more abrasive, Hubble.

spans.text: You've gotten a lot more abrasive, Hubble.

units.rawText: Hm... judging by your tone, you're not quite a "new friend". It's a shame, though. This nebula is thoroughly dark to me.
units.displayText: Hm... judging by your tone, you're not quite a "new friend". It's a shame, though. This nebula is thoroughly dark to me.

spans.text: Hm... judging by your tone, you're not quite a "new friend". It's a shame, though. This nebula is thoroughly dark to me.

units.rawText: Might you introduce her, Professor?
units.displayText: Might you introduce her, Professor?

spans.text: Might you introduce her, Professor?

units.rawText: This is Antonina. Our journey here to find you has been much assisted by her and the Agents of Jiutian.
units.displayText: This is Antonina. Our journey here to find you has been much assisted by her and the Agents of Jiutian.

spans.text: This is Antonina. Our journey here to find you has been much assisted by her and the Agents of Jiutian.

units.rawText: I see... Thank you, Antonina. What a shame—I truly cannot remember.
units.displayText: I see... Thank you, Antonina. What a shame—I truly cannot remember.

spans.text: I see... Thank you, Antonina. What a shame—I truly cannot remember.

units.rawText: Before you and Fresnel departed for Jiutian, I never imagined... that we would be in such circumstances when we speak again.
units.displayText: Before you and Fresnel departed for Jiutian, I never imagined... that we would be in such circumstances when we speak again.

spans.text: Before you and Fresnel departed for Jiutian, I never imagined... that we would be in such circumstances when we speak again.

units.rawText: But looking at the state you are in now, chances are you don't know what I'm talking about.
units.displayText: But looking at the state you are in now, chances are you don't know what I'm talking about.

spans.text: But looking at the state you are in now, chances are you don't know what I'm talking about.

units.rawText: That's well and good. No need for one of those emotional scenes.
units.displayText: That's well and good. No need for one of those emotional scenes.

spans.text: That's well and good. No need for one of those emotional scenes.

units.rawText: How very much like you, Antonina. Weren't you worrying a few days earlier?
units.displayText: How very much like you, Antonina. Weren't you worrying a few days earlier?

spans.text: How very much like you, Antonina. Weren't you worrying a few days earlier?

units.rawText: Let's get to business first, Professor, if you would☆
units.displayText: Let's get to business first, Professor, if you would☆

spans.text: Let's get to business first, Professor, if you would☆

units.rawText: Pfft... that's something I haven't seen in ages.
units.displayText: Pfft... that's something I haven't seen in ages.

spans.text: Pfft... that's something I haven't seen in ages.

units.rawText: Squeak!
units.displayText: Squeak!

spans.text: Squeak!

units.rawText: Antonina subtly glares at the miniature Entropic, still nestled on Hubble, displaying to us another information panel. This time, however, it is not the expedition-related data, but the more important—
units.displayText: Antonina subtly glares at the miniature Entropic, still nestled on Hubble, displaying to us another information panel. This time, however, it is not the expedition-related data, but the more important—

spans.text: Antonina subtly glares at the miniature Entropic, still nestled on Hubble, displaying to us another information panel. This time, however, it is not the expedition-related data, but the more important—

units.rawText: This is... my data?
units.displayText: This is... my data?

spans.text: This is... my data?

units.rawText: To be precise, various data records you've left behind, compared with the data we acquired from briefly scanning you just then.
units.displayText: To be precise, various data records you've left behind, compared with the data we acquired from briefly scanning you just then.

spans.text: To be precise, various data records you've left behind, compared with the data we acquired from briefly scanning you just then.

units.rawText: To be frank, I think your standing remains dubious... because judging by the signals, you're an Entropic.
units.displayText: To be frank, I think your standing remains dubious... because judging by the signals, you're an Entropic.

spans.text: To be frank, I think your standing remains dubious... because judging by the signals, you're an Entropic.

units.rawText: I don't know how you've maintained sanity, but to me, that's nothing more than a passing illusion.
units.displayText: I don't know how you've maintained sanity, but to me, that's nothing more than a passing illusion.

spans.text: I don't know how you've maintained sanity, but to me, that's nothing more than a passing illusion.

units.rawText: Rather, are you still really Hubble?
units.displayText: Rather, are you still really Hubble?

spans.text: Rather, are you still really Hubble?

units.rawText: Smoke and mirrors, maybe? Hehehe, who's to say.
units.displayText: Smoke and mirrors, maybe? Hehehe, who's to say.

spans.text: Smoke and mirrors, maybe? Hehehe, who's to say.

units.rawText: No matter what, Hubble has well and truly returned to us for now.
units.displayText: No matter what, Hubble has well and truly returned to us for now.

spans.text: No matter what, Hubble has well and truly returned to us for now.

units.rawText: Of course, the Entropic issue is very much real, and we can't take her back to the Oasis just like this. There's also the issue of the entire Starsphere that we must take care of.
units.displayText: Of course, the Entropic issue is very much real, and we can't take her back to the Oasis just like this. There's also the issue of the entire Starsphere that we must take care of.

spans.text: Of course, the Entropic issue is very much real, and we can't take her back to the Oasis just like this. There's also the issue of the entire Starsphere that we must take care of.

units.rawText: O all-capable master of the ways, Antonina, do you have any ideas?
units.displayText: O all-capable master of the ways, Antonina, do you have any ideas?

spans.text: O all-capable master of the ways, Antonina, do you have any ideas?

units.rawText: Don't you speak to me in that tone ever again... I do have a proposal, but we'll need Hubble's cooperation.
units.displayText: Don't you speak to me in that tone ever again... I do have a proposal, but we'll need Hubble's cooperation.

spans.text: Don't you speak to me in that tone ever again... I do have a proposal, but we'll need Hubble's cooperation.

units.rawText: Mine?
units.displayText: Mine?

spans.text: Mine?

units.rawText: Our understanding of you is still shallow, since we've only been able to run basic scans.
units.displayText: Our understanding of you is still shallow, since we've only been able to run basic scans.

units.rawText: If possible, I'd like you to link up to the analysis instruments mounted onboard... I'd like to see how stable your status is.

units.rawText: Is there a problem?

units.rawText: Do tell.

units.rawText: Every "Entropic" has a whole, complete Entropic core, even that little thing in your lap.
units.displayText: Every "Entropic" has a whole, complete Entropic core, even that little thing in your lap.

spans.text: Every "Entropic" has a whole, complete Entropic core, even that little thing in your lap.

units.rawText: If we follow and apply common principles to your Entropized state, you, too, should have a similar core...
units.displayText: If we follow and apply common principles to your Entropized state, you, too, should have a similar core...

units.rawText: Entropic... core?
units.displayText: Entropic... core?

spans.text: Entropic... core?

units.rawText: It's not on me? Then it might be asleep in this dreamscape as well.
units.displayText: It's not on me? Then it might be asleep in this dreamscape as well.

spans.text: It's not on me? Then it might be asleep in this dreamscape as well.

units.rawText: If you are indeed speaking of the same "star" as me.

units.rawText: An estranged core, huh...
units.displayText: An estranged core, huh...

units.rawText: As you told us earlier, you've only retained a part of your memory data. And if the other segments are indeed spread throughout this Starsphere...
